text: SUPERVISOR — UIFLAP escalation: the user is STILL getting GLYPH RASTERIZE spam live ("27 new glyphs baked... 242fps -> 77fps" every beat), and the witness cannot reproduce it. Stop trying to reproduce — instrument the USER's session instead: expose your recon-churn naming trace as a console verb (or extend gv_perflog) so the user can flip it on in their live session and the next CONTENT SWAP / GLYPH RASTERIZE spike logs WHICH component/subtree and WHICH text string + size requested the new glyphs. The glyph path is the strongest lead: 27 new glyphs at a NEW size every ~0.4s means some text's size or content is continuously changing — when the trace names the string, we have the component. Make the spike report itself print the offending text/node when the trace is armed. DONE-BAR: a verb the user can run, then their next spike names the culprit in the log line.
resolution: Resolved in b91a941962eeb56e3cbc631f1ac39f2ce59f10d7. Exposed the recon-churn owner trace and attached recent component/text/font-size evidence to spike reports, then moved the final owner payload to host-spike output so the user's live session can name exact glyph and StaticSurface offenders on the bad frame.
